say:1:1530148001:1.text: Of course it does. My soup's nothing like the slop they serve in the market.
say:1:1530148001:1.source_cn: 那当然！我熬的汤可和环集市场的，不一样！
say:1:1530148001:1.male: Of course it does. My soup's nothing like the slop they serve in the market.
say:1:1530148001:1.female: Of course it does. My soup's nothing like the slop they serve in the market.

say:2:1530148002:1.text: Those idiots think soup just means tossing in meat in hot water.
say:2:1530148002:1.source_cn: 那些夯货，只会想着往汤里加肉。
say:2:1530148002:1.male: Those idiots think soup just means tossing in meat in hot water.
say:2:1530148002:1.female: Those idiots think soup just means tossing in meat in hot water.

say:3:1530148003:1.text: Me? I add meat, bones, and mushrooms!
say:3:1530148003:1.source_cn: 但我不但多肉，还会加入骨头，还有蘑菇，去熬汤！
say:3:1530148003:1.male: Me? I add meat, bones, and mushrooms!
say:3:1530148003:1.female: Me? I add meat, bones, and mushrooms!
